title: Government budget by function, South Africa
basis: The figures are consolidated government expenditure by function from Table 5.4 of the Budget Review 2026 (National Treasury, 25 February 2026), in rand million, for FY 2025/26 as a revised estimate and FY 2026/27 as a budget estimate, with the sub-function rows the same table prints. Consolidation covers national and provincial government, social security funds and selected public entities financed from own revenue, as the table footnote states. Both years are estimates; neither is an outturn. Debt-service costs, the contingency reserve and the consolidated total are carried alongside so the function rows can be reconciled to the consolidated total, which the table does reconcile exactly.

sources.document: Budget Review 2026, National Treasury, Republic of South Africa, 25 February 2026
sources.used_for: Table 5.4 Consolidated government expenditure by function (PDF page 73) for every function and sub-function figure, and Table 1.5 Consolidated government expenditure by function (PDF page 25) as an independent second printing of the top level rows.
figures: consolidated expenditure by function, 2025/26 revised estimate
consolidated expenditure by function, 2026/27 budget estimate

conventions.page_numbers: Page references are the page of the PDF file at the source URL, with the printed page of the Budget Review in brackets where it differs.
conventions.function_vs_sector: South Africa classifies the budget by function, not by sector working group. The function names here are the ones the Budget Review prints and are not renamed to match the Kenyan sector names.
conventions.estimates: The 2025/26 column is a revised estimate; the 2026/27 column is a budget estimate. Neither is an audited outturn, and the two are different kinds of estimate, which is why each record carries its own label.
conventions.no_recurrent_development_split: Table 5.4 does not split each function into current and capital payments, so no such split is carried. The Budget Review gives the economic classification of consolidated expenditure in aggregate only.

reconciliation.contingency_reserve_note: Printed as a dash in Table 5.4, meaning no amount, and stored as null rather than as zero.
reconciliation.check: Allocated by function plus debt-service costs plus the contingency reserve reconciles to consolidated expenditure in both years, exactly, as the table prints it.

not_sourced: Provincial and municipal splits of each function. Not carried from Table 5.4 and not inferred.
Current and capital split per function. Not printed in Table 5.4.
Actual outturn by function. The Budget Review carries the FY 2025/26 column as a revised estimate, not as an audited outcome.
notes: Table 1.5 of the same Budget Review prints the same eight top level rows in rand billion to one decimal and agrees with Table 5.4 in every case, which is an independent check on the transcription.
Community development and Payments for financial assets are printed without sub-function rows in Table 5.4, so their sub_functions arrays are empty rather than guessed.
